name: VAPOR PANDA
description: CrowdStrike reports a China-nexus espionage actor running ARTEX, a multi-agent framework (main agent coordinating planner and worker agents over a shared graph of facts, findings and goals), driven primarily by DeepSeek plus a second commercial LLM CrowdStrike could not confirm. Starting 17 Oct 2026 the campaign hit 200+ organizations in 14+ countries over an 11-day window (post-exploitation confirmed at 9, password spraying/credential scanning against 12+ more), targeting foreign ministries, government, pharma, semiconductor, defense, nuclear, financial, telecom and think-tank organizations. One intrusion's planning agents consumed roughly 1.4 billion input tokens while a human operator steered in Chinese at decision points. Tooling included the BLOODALCHEMY backdoor, web shells and Chisel/SoftEther tunnels. *Analyst note: ATT&CK IDs below are a subset of those CrowdStrike lists; the second model is unconfirmed. Vendor source.* CrowdStrike
